'''Ralgos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Bombardment of Ralgos|bombardment]] took place on this planet, and destroyed multiple [[City/Legends|cities]]. This caused a local [[Police officer/Legends|lawman]], [[Danel Qurno]], to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
